summary: The customer called angrily to complain about a doubled internet bill after upgrading their plan without being informed of the price increase. The agent apologized, empathized, immediately canceled the upgrade without fees, and adjusted the bill to remove the extra charges. The call ended cordially with the customer satisfied and thanking the agent.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Cancel the upgrade, revert to the previous package immediately without any cancellation fees.

commitments.description: Adjust the bill and waive the extra charges as an apology.

evidence.text: معك حق تزعل، وبعتذر منك عن سوء التفاهم، خليني أتأكد من تفاصيل طلب الترقية على السيستم عندك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, professional demeanor despite the customer's initial anger and insults.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully resolved all customer complaints during the call by canceling the upgrade, reverting the package, and clearing the extra charges.
